about_the_game:
You play Bill, an ex-MMA champion turned billionaire, who has decided to cut himself off from the world by retreating to his private island. Unfortunately, he hadn't anticipated that his tranquility would be put to the test. On the same day, Bill was about to go into a rage! Young party people have landed on the beaches, an alien ship has crashed on the island, the undead have awakened, dragon and other monsters have appeared on the island, a mysterious virus has been spotted, the weather is acting up, etc. In short, it's time to put on the gloves and clean up!

The game takes place on a 5 km² island, which offers its share of caves (accessible or hidden), but also offers verticality (floating island, platforms, etc.). The island features a variety of different zones, including a volcano, snow-capped mountains, a desert, a secret hi-tech station, forests, beaches, lakes and rivers, a luxurious villa... The game features a day/night cycle and dynamic weather. An important element of the game is the easter eggs hidden everywhere, with huge nods to 80/90s and pop culture.

Raging Bill is a TPS sandbox in a mini open world It features different gameplay styles (Shooter & Melee Combat, Racing, Exploration, Loot, Bodycam, and more),

To get around the island more quickly, you'll have at your disposal a real hoverboard, zip lines, a boosted lawnmower, magic boots, jetpack, a raft, and more...

You master kung fu like no one else, but nothing stops you from throwing whatever falls into your hands (coconuts, bombs, bottles, balloons, stones, ...). Also at your disposal are weapons such as a toy blaster, plasma gun, retro gun, mines, ... But will you be able to unlock the ultimate power, which will allow you to fly and master telekinesis?

This is a physics-based game. Do you like playing with ragdolls? Then you've come to the right place!

The island is full of secret chests to find, where you can unlock cosmetic items (masks, hats, etc.), ammunition for your weapons, and other power-ups. A special chest will allow you to grow or shrink (and offers new gameplay possibilities), and other surprises to discover...

For collectors, 24 magazines featuring the hero are hidden in the game. Dozens of lost bees that you must return to their 5-star hive. And don't forget the virus that's spread across the island: destroy them all!

The game also has its share of puzzles, inaccessible areas, and various parkours that you'll have to challenge!

Are you a time trial enthusiast? Grab your remote-controlled car and speed around the island, don't hesitate to wreck everything along the way :)

Bosses are also part of the game, so it's up to you to find their weak points.

A whole bunch of accessories are unlockable (via chests or other challenges). Hint: Some will give you advantages that shouldn't be overlooked.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-11400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 5900x or Intel i7 12700k
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (12 GB), AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 GB) or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
